intended_object: The canonical inclusion of the connected components of p⁻¹(D₁*) into the set of points added in the compactification (filled cover) of a map p to the thrice-punctured sphere. Each component gives one added point lying over the puncture 1. Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and the companion lemmas puncture_overOne and sigmaEquiv_overOne.
explanation: FilledPoint p is the sum CC(p⁻¹ D₀*) ⊕ CC(p⁻¹ D₁*) ⊕ CC(p⁻¹ D_∞*). overOne is Sum.inr ∘ Sum.inl, the injection of the middle summand, i.e. the components over the puncture 1. This matches the rest of the file: the label `puncture` gives these points the value 1, sigmaEquiv sends them to ⟨.one, c⟩, and Puncture.neighborhood .one is puncturedNeighborhoodOne (the punctured disc of radius 1/2 about 1). overOne_injective also holds. The construction belongs to the specific setting of the thrice-punctured sphere and its three named punctures, and its domain is already general (any topological space E and any map p), so it is not too narrow. Mathlib has no counterpart.
